name: speaks
description: Reads Claude's replies aloud with Pocket TTS (local CPU), cleaning up paths, numbers and jargon for speech.

http_url.title: TTS server URL
http_url.description: An OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8880/v1/audio/speech for Kokoro-FastAPI. Empty: Pocket TTS only. Pocket also speaks whenever a request fails. ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} are expanded here and in every http_* option.

http_api_key.title: TTS server API key
http_api_key.description: Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. A literal key, or ${ENV_VAR} to read it from the environment at request time. Leave empty for a local server.

http_model.title: Model
http_model.description: The request's model field, e.g. kokoro or tts-1.

http_voice.title: Voice
http_voice.description: The request's voice field, e.g. af_heart.

http_sample_rate.title: Sample rate
http_sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the server's pcm output, in Hz.

http_timeout.title: Request timeout
http_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the server before falling back to Pocket TTS.

http_extra.title: Extra request fields
http_extra.description: JSON merged into the request body, e.g. {"speed": 1.1, "normalization_options": {"normalize": false}} for Kokoro-FastAPI.

http_text_profile.title: Text rules for the server
http_text_profile.description: kokoro: only what Kokoro's pronunciation gets wrong. pocket: spell everything out.

replacements.title: Replacements
replacements.description: Rules applied first, one 'find => replace' per entry. A plain word matches whole words (any case if written lowercase); /regex/ is a pattern. Pre-filled with the light rules; add your own, e.g. 'kubectl => cube control'.

pocket_voice.title: Pocket TTS voice
pocket_voice.description: Built-in Pocket voice: eponine, azelma, eve, jane, vera, jean, marius, … (alba is male).

volume_db.title: Volume boost (dB)
volume_db.description: Gain through a soft limiter. 0 is unchanged; 6 is a good start.

max_chars.title: Spoken length limit
max_chars.description: Characters spoken per reply before '… and more on screen'. 0 means no limit.
